title: Diagnostics exact representation-instance authority seam
objective: Provide the narrow project-owned source seam needed for Physics Lab diagnostics to prove that an enumerated Workspace representation is the exact runtime-owned Instance for its canonical WorldEntity id, without exposing the private representation map or treating Workspace as canonical data.

slots.role: Exact Instance ownership seam implementation and pure regression

acceptance: expose a narrow project-owned predicate that receives both canonical entity id and candidate Instance and succeeds only when the candidate is the exact private runtime-owned representation for that id
keep the private representation map private and preserve conceptual/resolved/physical separation
fail closed for substitute/stale/destroyed candidates and for ids with no currently owned representation
if parent/root membership is asserted, bind it to the canonical realized lab model without making Workspace the universe database
add a pure deterministic/source-contract regression that locks exact Instance identity semantics and is registered in the canonical pure test runner
do not edit diagnostics production code in this prerequisite lane; HG-BACKFILL-DIAGNOSTICS consumes the seam after this prerequisite lands
do not claim Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, or two-client evidence from source-only validation
canonical CI and fresh independent exact-head review are required before integration
